glosses: To run apart; to separate; to tend into different directions.

examples.text: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood, / And sorry I could not travel both / […]

examples.text: Both stories start out the same way, but they diverge halfway through.

glosses: To separate, to tend into a different direction (from another line or path).

examples.text: The sidewalk runs next to the street for a few miles, then diverges from it and turns north.

examples.text: The sequence x#95;n#61;n² diverges to infinity: that is, it increases without bound.
